name: ServiceTitan
description: ServiceTitan is a cloud-based field-service management platform for contractors — HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, pest control, and landscaping — offering dispatching, scheduling, invoicing, and reporting, priced per technician and positioned toward larger and enterprise-scale operations.
best_for: Larger and enterprise-scale contractor businesses that want the deepest reporting and dispatch tooling in the field-service category and are comfortable with a quote-only, per-technician pricing model.
features: Mobile field app with automated checklists
Advanced reporting on closing rates and team metrics
Customer experience tools including instant estimates and GPS tracking
Commission tracking and customizable membership programs (The Works tier)

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Dispatching, scheduling, call booking, invoicing, and pricebook. No public price — per-technician quote required.

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.notes: Adds mobile estimates and payroll management. No public price.

tiers.name: The Works
tiers.notes: Full suite: advanced reporting, commission tracking, customizable memberships. No public price.

pros: The most-recognized enterprise brand in field-service software, with the deepest reporting/dispatch feature set of the three compared here
Genuinely built for scale — customizable commission tracking and membership programs at the top tier
Strong marketing-ROI and call-booking tooling not matched by the smaller SMB-focused competitors
cons: No public pricing at all — every plan requires "Request Pricing," unlike Jobber and Housecall Pro's published tiers
Per-technician pricing model makes total cost hard to estimate without a sales call

faq.question: How much does ServiceTitan cost?
faq.answer: ServiceTitan does not publish pricing. It uses a per-technician pricing model across three tiers (Starter, Essentials, The Works), and every quote requires contacting ServiceTitan directly.

faq.question: Is ServiceTitan a good fit for a small contractor business?
faq.answer: ServiceTitan is generally positioned toward larger and enterprise-scale field-service operations; smaller teams often find Jobber or Housecall Pro's published, lower-cost tiers a more direct fit.

alternatives.name: Jobber
alternatives.description: Field service software tailored for small-to-midsize service businesses.
alternatives.best_for: Growing contractors seeking easy setup and transparent pricing

alternatives.name: Housecall Pro
alternatives.description: All-in-one operations platform for home service professionals.
alternatives.best_for: Residential contractors wanting mobile payments and dispatching
